uploadsafety-desc: Screens uploaded images and rejects content that fails moderation.
uploadsafety-upload-rejected: This image was rejected by content moderation.
uploadsafety-upload-rejected-debug: This image was rejected by content moderation. [$1]
uploadsafety-upload-unavailable: This image could not be checked by content moderation and was rejected.
uploadsafety-upload-unavailable-debug: This image could not be checked by content moderation and was rejected. [$1]
uploadsafety-upload-screen-limited: You are uploading images too quickly. Please wait a while and try again.
uploadsafety-upload-screen-limited-debug: You are uploading images too quickly. Please wait a while and try again. [$1]
uploadsafety-upload-reject-limited: Too many of your images were rejected by content moderation recently. Please wait a while and try again.

uploadsafety-upload-unscreened-restricte: Files of this type cannot be checked by content moderation, so only some users can upload them. Images in PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or AVIF format can be uploaded by anyone.
log-description-uploadsafety: Images rejected by automatic upload screening, and uploaders who reached the rejection limit. Rejected images are not kept; only their SHA-1 is recorded.
logentry-uploadsafety-reject: $1 {{GENDER:$2|uploaded}} an image for $3 that was rejected by the $5 check (score $6, surface $4, SHA-1 $7)
logentry-uploadsafety-limited: $1 {{GENDER:$2|reached}} the $5 limit after repeated rejected uploads (surface $4) and cannot upload images until it resets
right-uploadsafety-upload-unscreened: Upload files in formats content moderation cannot check, such as SVG
action-uploadsafety-upload-unscreened: upload files in formats content moderation cannot check
